headline: Bakkafrost shares drop 5.6% despite higher operational profit in Q3
summary: Faroese salmon farmer Bakkafrost reported a surge in third-quarter operational profit, but its shares fell 5.6% following the presentation of results.
why: Bakkafrost is a major European aquaculture producer, and its financial results reflect feed costs, biological conditions, and spot salmon pricing across Nordic markets.

impacts.name: Bakkafrost
impacts.why: Shares slipped 5.6% after the release of Q3 financial results.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bakkafrost shares fell 5.6% in reaction to its third-quarter earnings release despite a rise in headline operational profit.
